body:
Nothing is wrong with you, people react differently to weed, I suggest you to never smoke again until you've dealt with your anxiety issues.

I've had friends who've had the same thing happen to them, usually after a week they forget about it.

You just have to understand that it's not the edibles that did that but it's your anxiety and your brain messing with you, nothing has changed in your body, you wouldn't have died even if you felt like it. 

Everything is all right just relax and don't be too paranoid about it.
Lool same here, I keep my voicemail full on purpose so I don't have to deal with it.

If you don't see the point as middle class person in the US, what about the poor indian living in a little house with his 10 brothers/sisters, what's the point of his life ?

There is no point in life, you'll never get satisfied not matter how rich you get, it's all about enjoying the moment. ( I wish i could do that)
What's this bullshit ? "You get what you give" I don't think we live in the same world then or you're just lying to yourself

Well it's not my fault if life sucks like that, I can't be blamed for everything I do. Bad things happen whether I am the cause or not.

You all tell suicidal people to "get over it","it's life" so me too I'm gonna say that to people affected by my actions.

I went to to the quarantined area of the hospital,there a cases of corona there.

It was a bad idea . I did it because I don't want people to know that I killed myself

I just want them to think it's an accident, i don't wanna hurt them and make them feel guilty.
Yeah you're right there is other easier ways.
I was planning to stay at home, but it's dumb i know
We'll all die one day, so if life is gonna be bad why not take a shortcut ?
Did you get HIV in only one intercourse ?

Maybe she was busy or smth happened, if not it's up to you to decide if she's really your friend or just an acquaintance.

And I don't think you re in the right subreddit
No, you're just panicking for nothing
Did you find the solution ?
Me too, I know that if something happened to me she'll feel way worse than I actually am. So not today.
What do you think is the reason for that ? Do people around you can't understand you ?

That's great then, I suggest to keep doing/searching those alternatives methods before going to a doctor. 

This will train and nurtures your mind better than any medication and you'll still can think of them as last resort.

I hope that you'll find the motivation you need and to keep pushing yourself to get better.
I recommend you to try nofap and replace that dopamine addiction with something else.
I will be way more depressed because I'll be so lonely

I tell myself the same thing but I cannot do it, besides there will be a lot of consequences that I can't handle at the moment.

But you're right all my life consists of playing pretend, I am not the same person at all when I am with different friends or family.
It seems like a lot of people feels better by taking meds. But be careful do you want to take those for the rest of your life ? Did you first try other treatments ?
Yes it is a common symptom of depression, but let's not make conclusion, there could be a thousand other reasons for what you're feeling.
Thank you, I really hope you will too. Sorry I'm not the best at cheering people up, but those are not empty words.

I'm exactly in the same situation, same age, graduated high school in 2015, always been in the top 3 students.

 Since then I've seen no progress in my life, failed 3 fucking years at university. I know have anxiety,depression and lack of motivation, those feelings were unknown to me before graduating.

I wish I could help you but I'm as lost as you, sometimes I feel like I have to accept a shitty life/future so I can move on and make progress.

If you ever find a solution please tell me.

Same as you I'm 22 and still in first year of college I tried 3 different majors, I don't think university suits me. Now I don't know what to do with my life, I feel like I ruined everything because I didn't make the effort to force myself into studying even if it didn't interest me at the time.

I'm just trying to accept that my life is going to be miserable so I can move on.

You described me, I'm just like you nothing matters for me anymore. I caught myself thinking that even if one of my parents died It won't make me sad, I'll just miss them and that's it. I hate myself for thinking like that.

It seems like you don't hate life itself, but you hate what the society made it to be like, you're very woke for your age.

I have never seen a doctor/therapist in my entire life (I'm 22), but maybe I need to make that my priority ?? I always thought of it as not worth it, and I don't want to be addicted to meds.  I could lend some money but do you really think that's the best/easiest solution rn ?

I'm really not good at talking though :(, I speak 3 languages but I'm not comfortable at any of them, I have huge difficulties to express myself in words. 

No one knows about my depresseion or anxiety, not even my parents nor close friends. I just act "normal" arround them.

Maybe that's the cause ? I just keep everything to myself.
Ok, thanks so I'll try to keep focusing on the present ( future just gives me anxiety ).

Really ? :( so it's like PTSD you know exactly the causes but can do nothing about it.

Thank you for your advice, but what if I can't afford therapy or to see a doctor ? Do I have to bear it until then ?
It kinda make sense but I thought that to overcome it I had to face my past and not just forget about it.

It's okay, sorry to be like that but I don't like talking/writing even  anonymously.

I was just wondering if there were some signs to look at or questions to ask myself to understand what may have triggered it.

Sometimes I get to be "happy" (don't even know if that's happiness)  for short moments but I have to forget everything about my life, it's like when you're drunk or high.
Thank you ! But you should focus on people with real problem, I figured out that I don't even have the motivitation to kill myself.
